display.title: Episode 396: The Secret of the Empty Fireplace (Rosh Hashanah)
display.summary_short: Uncle Yossi's pre-Rosh Hashanah show: crowning Hashem as King, Shema with a guest from Illinois, and how the young Tzemach Tzedek hid in a fireplace to hear his grandfather teach Torah.
display.summary_long: Broadcast the week of Rosh Hashanah 5750. Uncle Yossi explains why we proclaim 'Hashem Melech' so often on Rosh Hashanah: on the very first Rosh Hashanah, the sixth day of creation, Adam HaRishon was the first to call Hashem King, and this gave Hashem great delight. Each year we crown Him again with our prayers and the shofar, and He accepts the crown and blesses us for the new year, which the Rebbe said would be a year of miracles. After the Hakochainik march, an eight-year-old girl visiting from Illinois with her parents to see the Rebbe leads the Shema and talks about receiving a dollar for tzedakah from the Rebbe. Story time honors the 200th birthday of the Tzemach Tzedek on Erev Rosh Hashanah. As a nine-year-old, too young to join his grandfather the Alter Rebbe's lessons, little Menachem Mendel hid in the empty fireplace to listen, until one cold evening the fire was lit; the Alter Rebbe's touch revived him. The show ends with reminders about the shofar on Sunday, since the first day falls on Shabbos, candle lighting with Shehecheyanu, and Tashlich on the second day.
display.lesson: Crown Hashem as King with joy on Rosh Hashanah, and love learning Torah so much that you would give anything for it.
